sections.title: 1. EXP & Leveling Guide (Lv. 1–99)
sections.summary: Fastest EXP progression brackets, DMW EXP mechanics, and why M8-6-4 Scissor Chitins dominates endgame leveling.

blocks.heading: Early to Midgame (Lv. 1–40)
blocks.body: Crisis Core ties level-ups to hidden EXP + DMW triple-number rolls (7-7-7). Progress M1, M3, M4, and M7 missions early; once you unlock Status Ward + Hell Blizzaga, wipe 6–7★ encounters in seconds.

blocks.heading: Endgame EXP (M8-6-4 Scissor Chitins)
blocks.body: Equip Costly Punch + Brutal or Genji Glove (or Buster Sword at 23%+ proficiency) and loop M8-6-4 (Scissor Chitins) or M9-6-x encounters. High-level enemies feed huge hidden EXP so DMW 7-7-7 triggers frequently.

sections.title: 2. SP & Gil Farming Master Guide
sections.summary: Mog's Amulet + Jeweled Ring economy break, M9-5-3 Three Stars, M6-6-3 Lesser Worms, and Minerva's 99x Phoenix Downs.

blocks.heading: Mandatory Farming Gear
blocks.body: Buy Mog's Amulet (10,000 Gil, Sector 7 Shop via M4-4-3) so enemies always drop Rare Drops, and Brigand's Gloves (10,000 Gil) for 100% Steal/Mug success. In Online Shop Shade (M9-5-4), buy Jeweled Ring (10,000 Gil) to double item/Materia drop quantity and Precious Watch (10,000 Gil) to double Gil earned from battles.

blocks.heading: M9-5-3 (Three Stars) & Minerva
blocks.body: M9-5-3 is the #1 SP and Gil farm in Reunion—Three Stars and Tycoon yield massive SP plus sellable Mythril Armlets and Tri-Thundaga. If you already unlocked M9-6-6, Mug Minerva for 99x Phoenix Downs (495,000 Gil per run) and flee or die to repeat.

sections.title: 3. Stat Fusion Material Farming & 98/980% Pipeline
sections.summary: Reunion changes (no repeat clear rewards), M7-2-1 Item Fusion Tome, Potion HP% rule, M6-6-3 Dark Matter, and 98/980% Libra conversion.

blocks.heading: Reunion Difference: No Repeatable Clear Rewards
blocks.body: Unlike PSP, Crisis Core Reunion only awards Mission Clear Rewards once. Instead of re-clearing missions for 99 items, farm Dark Matter from Lesser Worms in M6-6-3 (with Mog's Amulet) and convert +98 MAG Libra Materia into any stat!

blocks.heading: Consumable Potion HP% Rule
blocks.body: Clear M7-2-1 in Chapter 4 for the Item Fusion Tome. Consumables (Potion, Hi-Potion, Ether, Elixir) ONLY amplify an EXISTING matching stat bonus on one of the two Materia! Two +0 Materia + 99 Potions = +0%. Fuse an HP Up (+10% HP) with cheap 50 Gil Potions (20 = +10% HP) first.

blocks.heading: The 98 / 980% Conversion Loop
blocks.body: Never push an intermediate Libra transfer Materia to +99 or +999%—stop at +98 (or +980% HP). Then fuse that +98 Libra with your target skill (e.g., Costly Punch, Curaga, Aerial Drain) plus just ONE Hero Drink / Adamantite / Mythril / Fat Chocobo Feather to switch the stat and hit max cleanly.

sections.title: 4. Materia Leveling & Complete 18-Image DMW 100% Guide
sections.summary: Exact hidden EXP & slot 1–6 reels, Moogle Power (M8-4-4), M1-1-1 AFK loop, and unlocking all 18 DMW entries.

blocks.heading: How Materia Leveling & DMW Memories Work
blocks.body: DMW reels spin continuously during battle. Matching numbers 1–6 level up the Materia in that slot; triple matches give +2/+3 levels. Character DMW % advances as you view each character's 6 memory scenes (skipping them still counts!). Summons/Chocobo Modes jump straight to 100% after triggering once.

blocks.heading: M1-1-1 AFK Mastering & 100% DMW Loop
blocks.body: Equip Faerie Ring (auto-Regen) + Safety Bit + 1–2 mastered Moogle Power Materia (M8-4-4) or DMW-boost Materia (from QMC+ / Shade), enter M1-1-1, and let weak troopers tap Zack while the DMW masters all 6 Materia slots and fills missing DMW memories. Remember to finish the mission so progress saves!

sections.title: 5. Magic Pot Complete Encounters Guide
sections.summary: Exact locations and attack sequences for every Magic Pot encounter, including M10-2-3 (DMW) and M7-6-6 (Genji Shield).

blocks.heading: M10-2-3: Unlock Magic Pot DMW (Do This First!)
blocks.body: Equip Jump, Fira, Gravity, and Assault Twister. Enter M10-2-3 (Master Tonberry), dodge Tonberries until Magic Pot appears, do NOT attack it blindly—wait for its speech bubbles and cast Jump -> Fira -> Gravity -> Assault Twister in order.

blocks.heading: M7-6-6: Obtain Genji Shield
blocks.body: Equip Gil Toss, Costly Punch, Break Damage Limit (Brutal/Genji Glove/Buster Sword 23%+), and Octaslash Materia (Research Dept. QMC+). In M7-6-6, perform: Gil Toss -> Costly Punch -> 99,999 Damage -> Octaslash DMW. (Note: M2-2-6 & M2-5-4 also host early Magic Pots requesting Blizzard/Fire/Thunder/Gravity or Ultima.)

sections.title: 6. Buster Sword Proficiency & Skill Power (Reunion)
sections.summary: How the 4 Proficiency pools add up to 100%, unlocking Break Damage Limit at 23% and Barrier Pierce at 47%, plus Skill Power cancellation.

blocks.heading: 4 Proficiency Pools (100% Cap)
blocks.body: Proficiency splits across Perfect Guard in Battle Stance (31.66%), Strong Attack kills (31.66%), Command Materia kills from Battle Stance (31.66%), and Barrier-Piercing kills (5%). At 23% you unlock Battle Stance Damage Limit Break (99,999); at 47% you shatter enemy Barriers automatically.

blocks.heading: Fastest Farm & Skill Power Gauge
blocks.body: Farm Perfect Guards in M1-2-1 against rapid-fire gunners, Strong Attack & Command kills in M1-1-3 (50 Shinra Troopers), and Barrier kills in M9-6-5. Against Reunion bosses, dump Battle Stance Costly Punch into their Skill Power bar to weaken or completely cancel their Limit Breaks!

sections.title: 7. Chapter-by-Chapter Missables & 100% Checklist
sections.summary: Every permanently missable quest, shop, mail sender, and summon from Prologue to Chapter 10.

blocks.heading: Chapter 1–7 (Midgar Point of No Return)
blocks.body: Finish Fort Tamblin's 16 groups & Supply Pod Cursed Ring in Ch. 1, join all 3 Fan Clubs by Ch. 3, ace Aerith's Ch. 4 mini-games, talk to the Reporter & Silver Elite in Ch. 5, Cissnei in Ch. 6, and clear ALL Midgar NPC mission triggers before ending Chapter 7.

blocks.heading: Chapter 8–9 Critical Missables
blocks.body: In Ch. 8 Nibelheim, inspect the Water Tower via the Seven Wonders quest for the missable Phoenix DMW summon. In Ch. 9/10 Gongaga, open the outskirts chest for Research Dept. QMC+—if missed, you cannot unlock all 16 shops on that run.

sections.title: 8. Hard Mode Combat Meta & Genji Blueprint
sections.summary: Wall, Costly Punch, Aerial Drain, Status Ward + Hell-aga, and where to collect all 4 Genji pieces + Ziedrich/Heike Soul.

blocks.heading: Core Hard Mode Loadout
blocks.body: Run Costly Punch (99,999 defense-ignoring damage), Aerial Drain (i-frames + full heal), Curaga, Wall (or Genji Shield), Status Ward + Hell Blizzaga (ailment immunity + AoE Death), and Dualcast/Electrocute or Mug.

blocks.heading: Genji Gear Locations
blocks.body: Genji Helm: Online Shop Shade (M9-5-4, 1,000,000 Gil). Genji Armor: 100% DMW completion. Genji Shield: Magic Pot in M7-6-6. Genji Glove: Chest in M9-6-4. Bonus: Adaman Bangle (M7-3-6), Brutal (M7-4-6), Ziedrich (M9-5-6 chest), Heike Soul (100% of all 300 missions).

sections.title: 9. Hard Mode Superboss: Minerva (20,000,000 HP)
sections.summary: Stat requirements, Phoenix Down loop, dodging Judgment Arrow & Photon Feather, and depleting Skill Power on Hard Mode.

blocks.heading: Mandatory Pre-Fight Stats & Gear
blocks.body: Hard Mode Minerva has 20,000,000 HP, 255 ATK/MAG, and 255 SPR. Reach 255 VIT, 255 SPR, and 99,999 HP. Equip Genji Helm, Genji Armor, Genji Shield, and Genji Glove (or Ziedrich + Adaman Bangle). Bring Costly Punch, Aerial Drain, Curaga, Mug, and SP Master/Stat-stick Materia.

blocks.heading: Tactics & Judgment Arrow Counter
blocks.body: Mug her immediately for 99x Phoenix Downs and keep Auto-Raise active at ALL times—Judgment Arrow dispels Raise and hits hard, so deplete her Skill Power bar when Judgment Arrow charges, or time Aerial Drain's invulnerability frames. Use Battle Stance Costly Punch behind her back for 99,999 hits until Divine Slayer drops.

sections.title: 10. Materia Fusion Class Rules & Key Recipes
sections.summary: How Materia rank & classes determine fusion output, plus the most important Hard Mode fusions.

blocks.heading: Mastered Bonus & Class Priority
blocks.body: Fusing two Mastered Materia often bumps the resulting Materia up a grade (e.g., Fira -> Firaga). Combining Magic + Command usually yields a Command or Dark Magic ability, while Special (Purple) Materia like Libra/HP Up act as clean stat carriers without altering your primary attack skill when fused properly.

blocks.heading: Interactive Simulator
blocks.body: Use the Fusion Calc & Tracker tab to test Materia stat combinations, check Consumable vs. Mako/Stat Stone vs. Max-Tier catalyst caps, and jump directly to enemy farming spots for any catalyst.

farmingPlaybooks.title: EXP & Character Leveling Playbook
farmingPlaybooks.summary: How hidden EXP + DMW 7-7-7 level-ups work, and the fastest EXP missions from Chapter 1 to Lv 99.

steps.detail: Clear M1, M3, and M4 story-unlocked branches naturally. Level-ups occur when hidden EXP crosses a threshold AND the DMW hits 7-7-7; banked EXP carries over seamlessly so you never lose progress.
Buy Status Ward + Hell Blizzaga from Wutai Secret Shop (M4-2-6). Pairing them gives immunity to status ailments while wiping non-boss encounters via instant Death for rapid 6–7★ EXP.
Farm Scissor Chitins in M8-6-4 (5,460 EXP each) with Costly Punch + Break Damage Limit, or clear Goliath encounters in M9-6-5 (23,264 EXP each) once your VIT/SPR are 200+.

farmingPlaybooks.proTip: You do NOT need to sit in one spot waiting for 7-7-7—hidden EXP accumulates silently and triggers multiple rapid level-ups as soon as the DMW rolls 7-7-7.

farmingPlaybooks.title: SP (SOLDIER Points) Farming Playbook
farmingPlaybooks.summary: Fund million-SP endgame Materia fusions and SP Master builds without running dry.

steps.detail: Convert duplicate low-rank Materia into SP via the Materia menu, and farm Mover EX / Lesser Worms in M6-6-3 while collecting Dark Matter.
Run M9-5-3 (Unusually Strong Monsters). Three Stars grants 20,000 SP per kill—equip Costly Punch + Break Damage Limit to one-shot packs on repeat.
Each Minerva clear yields 40,000 SP (plus 99x Phoenix Downs via Mug). For pure speed per minute, M9-5-3 Three Stars remains faster.

farmingPlaybooks.proTip: Always keep a buffer of 500k+ SP before combining high-tier +98/+980% Materia—SP Turbo / SP Master also drain SP per hit in combat.

farmingPlaybooks.title: Gil & Rare Drop Economy Playbook
farmingPlaybooks.summary: Break the game's Gil economy to afford 1,000,000 Gil Genji Helm and unlimited shop Materia.

steps.detail: Mog's Amulet (Sector 7 Shop M4-4-3) forces Rare Drops; Brigand's Gloves guarantees 100% Steal/Mug; Jeweled Ring doubles item drops; Precious Watch doubles battle Gil (both in Online Shop Shade M9-5-4).
Equip Mog's Amulet + Jeweled Ring + Precious Watch + Mug in M9-5-3. Sell stolen Tri-Thundaga / Mythril Armlets and dropped accessories for 50,000+ Gil/minute.
Enter M9-6-6, Mug Minerva once to steal 99x Phoenix Downs, then intentionally lose or finish. Selling 99x Phoenix Downs nets 495,000 Gil per run.

farmingPlaybooks.proTip: Don't waste Gil on consumables late-game once you have Curaga + Aerial Drain; save 1,000,000 Gil first for Genji Helm in Online Shop Shade.

farmingPlaybooks.title: Max-Tier Fusion Material Playbook
farmingPlaybooks.summary: Since Reunion removed repeatable Mission Clear Rewards, use the M6-6-3 Dark Matter + 98/980% Libra loop alongside direct catalyst farms.

steps.detail: Equip Mog's Amulet + Jeweled Ring in M6-6-3. Lesser Worms drop Dark Matter reliably—stack 98 Dark Matter onto a cheap Libra Materia (+98 MAG), then fuse with JUST ONE target catalyst (Adamantite/Mythril/Hero Drink/Fat Chocobo Feather) to convert it!
Adamantite (VIT): Goliath in M9-6-5 (Drop & Steal), Crazy Sword in M7-6-4/M9-4-1, Grandpanzer in M9-3-3. Mythril (SPR): G Purgatorio in M3-4-6 / M8-6-6 (Rare Drop & Steal).
Hero Drink (ATK): Master Blade in M9-6-3 or Iron Claw in M6-5-6/M9-3-6. Fat Chocobo Feather (HP%): Jabberwock in M9-2-6 or Humbaba in M6-6-6 (also 50 Gil Shinra Potions amplify existing HP%!).

farmingPlaybooks.proTip: Never farm 99 Adamantite or 99 Gysahl Greens manually unless you want to—98 Dark Matter + 1 single target catalyst achieves the exact same +100 stat!

farmingPlaybooks.title: Materia Leveling & AFK Mastering Playbook
farmingPlaybooks.summary: How hidden Materia EXP and DMW slot 1–6 reels level Materia, plus the zero-effort M1-1-1 AFK setup.

steps.detail: Complete M8-4-4 (Suspicious Mail 4) to unlock Moogle on DMW, then buy Moogle Power Materia from Junon Souvenirs (M2-4-1).

steps.stage: 2. Set Up the AFK M1-1-1 Loadout
steps.detail: Equip 1–2 Moogle Power Materia (levels ALL equipped Materia at once when Moogle triggers) in slots alongside the Materia you want to master, plus Faerie Ring (auto-Regen).
Enter M1-1-1, leave 1 Sentry alive (or hold block), and let DMW reels spin. CRITICAL: You MUST finish the mission before exiting—forfeiting discards Materia levels!

farmingPlaybooks.proTip: Matching two numbers 1–6 levels the Materia in that exact slot number; triple matches jump +2 or +3 levels immediately.

farmingPlaybooks.title: Buster Sword Proficiency Playbook (Reunion)
farmingPlaybooks.summary: Reunion-exclusive stance progression: unlock Damage Limit Break at 23% and Barrier Piercing at 47%.

steps.detail: Enter M1-2-1, hold Battle Stance near the rapid-fire Security Officers in the lower area, and absorb gunfire blocks repeatedly.
Enter M1-1-3 (50 Shinra Troopers). Enter Battle Stance before every swing or AoE Command Materia (Darkness / High Jump) until both pools cap out.
Wait until enemies cast Barrier/MBarrier in late missions like M9-6-5, then finish them while in Battle Stance to hit 100%.

farmingPlaybooks.proTip: Every time you see a boss charging a Skill Power bar in Reunion, enter Battle Stance and hit with Costly Punch—draining the gauge weakens or cancels their Limit Break.

farmingPlaybooks.title: 100% DMW & Genji Armor Playbook
farmingPlaybooks.summary: Unlock all 7 Characters + 11 Summons/Chocobo Modes and push every entry to 100%.

steps.detail: Talk to the boy near Nibelheim Inn in Chapter 8 and examine the Water Tower for Phoenix (the ONLY missable DMW). Clear M8-1-1, M8-1-4, M8-1-6, M8-4-1..4, M8-5-6, M10-1-3, M10-2-3 for the rest.
Summons & Chocobo Modes jump straight to 100% the very first time they trigger. Characters require viewing 6 memory scenes each (you can skip cutscenes and still get credit!).
Buy DMW-boost Materia from Research Dept. QMC+ (Ch. 9), Junon Souvenirs (M2-4-1), and Bone Village Outlet (M7-5-3), equip them in M1-1-1 with Faerie Ring, and idle until 100% → Genji Armor!

farmingPlaybooks.proTip: Check the Shops, DMW & Missables tab to check off all 18 DMW portraits and verify you bought the exact boost Materia.

statLevelingGuides.title: HP% Stat-Leveling Materia Guide
statLevelingGuides.whyMatters: Costly Punch ignores enemy VIT/DEF and deals 99,999 damage when Zack's current HP is high. Paired with Adaman Bangle or Genji Armor (Break HP Limit), +999% HP lets Zack survive Minerva's Judgment Arrow.
statLevelingGuides.consumableRule: 20 Potions = +10% (10 Hi-Potions / 5 X-Potions / 1 Elixir = +10%). CRITICAL: Consumables ONLY work if one of the two fused Materia ALREADY has an HP% bonus!

phases.detail: Buy HP Up from Sector 8 Materia Shop (M6-2-1) so you already have an HP% stat. Fuse it with cheap 50 Gil Shinra Shop Potions (99 Potions = +40–50% per fusion) or mix in HP Mako Stones.
Use HP Stones (3 = +10%, max +660%) or keep stacking Potions/Hi-Potions onto a Libra carrier until you cross +500% HP. Equip Adaman Bangle (M7-3-6) to break the 9,999 HP ceiling.
Build a Libra up to +980% HP using Potions/X-Potions/Elixirs or Fat Chocobo Feathers (Jabberwock M9-2-6 / Humbaba M6-6-6), then fuse with Costly Punch + 1–2 Fat Chocobo Feathers to hit +999% HP.

statLevelingGuides.proTip: One single +999% HP Materia plus Zack's Lv. 70+ base HP (~7,500–9,999) + Genji Armor/Adaman Bangle easily reaches 99,999 HP without wasting a second Materia slot on HP%!

statLevelingGuides.title: VIT (Vitality) Stat-Leveling Materia Guide
statLevelingGuides.whyMatters: Reduces all physical damage taken on Hard Mode. At 255 VIT + Barrier/Wall, endgame bosses deal survivable chip damage instead of 50,000+ one-shots.
statLevelingGuides.consumableRule: No shop consumable raises VIT—start with VIT Mako Stones, Guard Stones, or Dark Matter converted via Adamantite.

phases.detail: Farm VIT Mako Stones (5 = +1 VIT, max +40) from early Shinra/Wutai missions and stack onto a Libra or Barrier Materia.
Steal Guard Stones (3 = +1 VIT, max +66) from Crazy Sword (M3-5-4 / M7-6-4) or heavy mech units while unlocking Break Limit gear.
Either farm Adamantite directly from Goliath (M9-6-5) / Crazy Sword (M7-6-4, M9-4-1) / Grandpanzer (M9-3-3), OR stack 98 Dark Matter on Libra in M6-6-3 and convert with just 1–2 Adamantite!

statLevelingGuides.proTip: At Lv. 75+, Zack has ~60–75 base VIT. One +100 VIT Materia + Ziedrich (+100 VIT) or Divine Slayer (+50 VIT) + a second +100 VIT Materia hits the 255 cap cleanly.

statLevelingGuides.title: SPR (Spirit) Stat-Leveling Materia Guide
statLevelingGuides.whyMatters: Reduces all magical damage (including Minerva's Ultima, Crimson Flare, and Krysta) and boosts Curaga healing.
statLevelingGuides.consumableRule: Phoenix Down acts as a +1 SPR (max +100) catalyst in Materia Fusion! You can steal 99x from Minerva (M9-6-6) or convert via Mythril.

phases.detail: Stack SPR Mako Stones (5 = +1 SPR, max +40) onto Cura or Barrier early for magic defense against mages.
Equip Mog's Amulet + Brigand's Gloves and Mug G Purgatorio in M3-4-6 (or M8-6-6) for direct Mythril (+1 SPR each, max +100) and Mind Stones.
Build a +98 Dark Matter Libra in M6-6-3 and fuse with 1–2 Mythril (or Phoenix Downs stolen from Minerva in M9-6-6) onto Curaga or Status Ward.

statLevelingGuides.proTip: Always put +100 SPR on your healing/defensive staple (Curaga or Wall) and +100 VIT on Aerial Drain or Mug so your stats never leave your loadout when swapping offensive spells.

statLevelingGuides.title: ATK (Attack) Stat-Leveling Materia Guide
statLevelingGuides.whyMatters: Maximizes Battle Stance Strong Attacks, Aerial Drain, High Jump, Assault Twister+, and Mug. Note: Costly Punch ignores ATK and scales off HP instead!
statLevelingGuides.consumableRule: No consumable raises ATK—use ATK Mako Stones, Power Stones, or Hero Drinks (1 = +1 ATK, max +100).

phases.detail: Stack ATK Mako Stones (5 = +1 ATK, max +40) onto Assault Twister or Jump in early chapters.
Use Power Stones (3 = +1 ATK, max +66) dropped by mid/late physical enemies and clear rewards.
Farm Hero Drinks from Master Blade (M9-6-3) or Iron Claw (M6-5-6 / M9-3-6), or convert a +98 Dark Matter Libra using 1–2 Hero Drinks onto Aerial Drain.

statLevelingGuides.proTip: If you run a Costly Punch build for Minerva, prioritize HP%, VIT 255, and SPR 255 BEFORE ATK—only add +100 ATK on your 4th/5th slot once defenses are capped.

statLevelingGuides.title: MAG (Magic) Stat-Leveling Materia Guide
statLevelingGuides.whyMatters: Drives Electrocute, Energy, Quake, Ultima, Hell-aga, and Curaga. Because Dark Matter is effortless to farm in M6-6-3, MAG is the universal backbone for leveling ALL other stats!
statLevelingGuides.consumableRule: No consumable raises MAG—Dark Matter (1 = +1 MAG, max +100) is the fastest-farmed catalyst in the game.

phases.detail: Feed MAG Mako Stones (5 = +1 MAG, max +40) into Fira/Blizzara/Thundara for early caster clears.
Lesser Worms in M6-6-3 drop both Dark Matter (Common) and Magic Stones (Rare) at once.
Farm 99x Dark Matter from Lesser Worms in M6-6-3 (with Mog's Amulet + Jeweled Ring). Fuse 98 onto Libra for any stat conversion, or 99 directly onto Dualcast/Electrocute/Ultima!

statLevelingGuides.proTip: Keep a spare stack of 99 Dark Matter at all times—it turns any new Materia into a +98/+100 stat stick in 60 seconds.

statLevelingGuides.title: LCK (Luck) Stat-Leveling Materia Guide
statLevelingGuides.whyMatters: Increases Critical Hit rate and slightly aids drop/steal consistency. Note: Genji Glove guarantees 100% critical hits regardless of LCK.
statLevelingGuides.consumableRule: No consumable raises LCK—use LCK Mako Stones, Luck Stones, or Gysahl Greens (1 = +1 LCK, max +100).

phases.detail: Only invest spare LCK stones if not equipping Genji Glove.
Grab Gysahl Greens from M9-6-x chests or M10-3-2, then convert a +98 Dark Matter Libra with 1 Gysahl Greens if you want 255 LCK without Genji Glove.

statLevelingGuides.proTip: If you already wear Genji Glove (M9-6-4) or Divine Slayer (M9-6-6), skip LCK completely and put VIT/SPR/ATK/MAG on your Materia slots instead.

statLevelingGuides.title: MP% Stat-Leveling Materia Guide
statLevelingGuides.whyMatters: Fuels Dualcast + Ultima / Electrocute / Curaga spam before you obtain Genji Helm (which makes all MP & AP costs 0).
statLevelingGuides.consumableRule: 10 Ethers = +10% MP (max +999%). Requires an EXISTING MP% bonus on one of the two fused Materia!

phases.detail: Buy MP Up from Sector 8 Materia Shop (M6-2-1) and feed cheap Shinra Shop Ethers (200 Gil) or MP Mako Stones.

phases.phase: Endgame (Lunar Harp or Skip via Genji Helm)
phases.detail: Convert a +980% HP/MP Libra with 1 Lunar Harp if needed, OR buy Genji Helm from Online Shop Shade (M9-5-4) for 1,000,000 Gil to make MP% completely unnecessary!

statLevelingGuides.proTip: Once you buy Genji Helm (0 MP/AP cost), replace any +MP% Materia with +HP%, +VIT, +SPR, or +MAG.

statLevelingGuides.title: AP% Stat-Leveling Materia Guide
statLevelingGuides.whyMatters: Powers Aerial Drain, High Jump, and Assault Twister+ spam before acquiring Genji Helm (0 AP cost). Note: Costly Punch costs HP, not AP!
statLevelingGuides.consumableRule: 10 Soma = +10% AP (max +999%). Requires an EXISTING AP% bonus on one of the two fused Materia!

phases.detail: Buy AP Up from Sector 8 Materia Shop (M6-2-1) and stack Shinra Shop Soma (200 Gil) or AP Stones.
Convert with 1 Zeio Nut (M9-6-x chests) if needed, or simply equip Genji Helm (M9-5-4) for infinite AP.

statLevelingGuides.proTip: Buster Sword Proficiency's passive Necromose also refunds MP/AP on every kill, making dedicated +AP% Materia rarely needed.
